-- Final Consumer: CV_COMP_SKF_BUDGET_STATIC
-- Generated by: BigQuery SQL Consolidation Agent
-- All HANA column names replaced with BQ_COLUMN values from Columns_Mapping.csv
-- All HANA table names replaced with BQ_FULL_TABLE values from Columns_Mapping.csv
-- Runtime Parameters:
--   @ip_version       STRING  - Budget version (default 'LEDGER_BUD'); compared to bic_zio_ver (STRING) and comp_ver (STRING)
--   @ip_week_ending_from STRING - Start week filter; compared to bic_zio_sweek (STRING)
--   @ip_week_ending_to   STRING - End week filter; compared to bic_zio_sweek (STRING)
--   @v_week              STRING - Prior fiscal week; derived from SFN_PRIOR_FISCAL_WEEK() (unresolved external function);
--                                  used in COMP_FLAG_BUDGET_SRC filter zweek = @v_week;
--                                  compared to zweek (STRING) in v_ztsrp_compfl
-- =============================================================================

WITH

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 1: FROZEN_CUBE
-- Logic: Selects SKF budget quantity data from the Frozen Cube source
--        (AZSRP_DS092_VT_S4 → BQ: v_bic_azsrp_ds092). Applies client
--        filter (mandt IN ('110','200')) and the @ip_fc_count != '0'
--        condition indicating a frozen forecast cycle is active.
--        Maps _BIC_ZIO_PCTR → b631_s_proftctr and _BIC_ZIO_CCTR →
--        b631_s_costcntr are NOT applicable here (DS092 has its own
--        b631_s_proftctr and b631_s_costcntr columns directly).
-- Source: edp-qa-finstorage.edp_saps4_shared_cnsv.v_bic_azsrp_ds092
-- Filters: mandt IN ('110','200'); @ip_fc_count != '0'
-- =====================================================================
FROZEN_CUBE AS (
  SELECT
    fiscper,
    fiscvarnt,
    bic_zio_sweek,
    fiscyear,
    fiscper3,
    b631_s_chrtacct,
    bic_zio_psty,
    bic_zio_pskf,
    b631_s_co_area,
    bic_zio_cmpcd,
    b631_s_proftctr,
    b631_s_costcntr,
    b631_s_funcarea,
    bic_zio_ver,
    bic_zio_saudt,
    mandt,
    recordmode,
    unit,
    bic_zio_skfq
  FROM
    `edp-qa-finstorage.edp_saps4_shared_cnsv.v_bic_azsrp_ds092`
  WHERE
    mandt IN ('110', '200')
    AND @ip_fc_count != '0'
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 2: LIVE_CUBE
-- Logic: Selects SKF budget quantity data from the Live Cube source
--        (AZSRP_DS031_VT_S4 → BQ: v_bic_azsrp_ds031). Applies client
--        filter (mandt IN ('110','200')) and @ip_fc_count = '0'
--        condition indicating no frozen forecast cycle is active.
--        Maps bic_zio_pctr → b631_s_proftctr and bic_zio_cctr →
--        b631_s_costcntr per the UNION mapping in CV_BASE_SKF_WEEKLY_BUDGET_S4.
--        b631_s_chrtacct and b631_s_funcarea are set to '' (empty string)
--        as per the Calculation View union mapping.
-- Source: edp-qa-finstorage.edp_saps4_shared_cnsv.v_bic_azsrp_ds031
-- Filters: mandt IN ('110','200'); @ip_fc_count = '0'
-- =====================================================================
LIVE_CUBE AS (
  SELECT
    fiscper,
    fiscvarnt,
    bic_zio_sweek,
    fiscyear,
    fiscper3,
    ''                  AS b631_s_chrtacct,
    bic_zio_psty,
    bic_zio_pskf,
    b631_s_co_area,
    bic_zio_cmpcd,
    bic_zio_pctr        AS b631_s_proftctr,
    bic_zio_cctr        AS b631_s_costcntr,
    ''                  AS b631_s_funcarea,
    bic_zio_ver,
    bic_zio_saudt,
    mandt,
    recordmode,
    unit,
    bic_zio_skfq
  FROM
    `edp-qa-finstorage.edp_saps4_shared_cnsv.v_bic_azsrp_ds031`
  WHERE
    mandt IN ('110', '200')
    AND @ip_fc_count = '0'
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 3: WEEKLY_SNAPSHOT_DS05
-- Logic: Combines FROZEN_CUBE (FLAG='FC') and LIVE_CUBE (FLAG='LC')
--        via UNION ALL, then aggregates to compute the effective
--        bic_zio_skfq using the Calculation View logic:
--        IF(SUM(FC) IS NULL, SUM(LC), SUM(FC)).
--        Applies the CV_COMP_SKF_BUDGET_STATIC filters:
--          fiscvarnt = 'K4'
--          bic_zio_sweek BETWEEN @ip_week_ending_from AND @ip_week_ending_to
--          bic_zio_ver = @ip_version
--          bic_zio_saudt IN ('1','10')
--          bic_zio_pskf IN ('804013','801000')
--        The FLAG column is retained for downstream use in the final
--        output (aliased as skf_bud_cube).
-- Source: FROZEN_CUBE, LIVE_CUBE
-- Filters: fiscvarnt='K4'; bic_zio_sweek BETWEEN params; bic_zio_ver=@ip_version;
--          bic_zio_saudt IN ('1','10'); bic_zio_pskf IN ('804013','801000')
-- Aggregation: GROUP BY all non-measure columns; SUM(FC) / SUM(LC) measure logic
-- =====================================================================
WEEKLY_SNAPSHOT_DS05 AS (
  SELECT
    fiscper,
    fiscvarnt,
    fiscyear,
    fiscper3,
    mandt,
    recordmode,
    bic_zio_sweek,
    b631_s_co_area,
    bic_zio_cmpcd,
    b631_s_proftctr,
    b631_s_costcntr,
    b631_s_chrtacct,
    b631_s_funcarea,
    bic_zio_ver,
    bic_zio_saudt,
    bic_zio_psty,
    bic_zio_pskf,
    unit,
    IF(
      SUM(CASE WHEN flag = 'FC' THEN bic_zio_skfq ELSE NULL END) IS NULL,
      SUM(CASE WHEN flag = 'LC' THEN bic_zio_skfq ELSE NULL END),
      SUM(CASE WHEN flag = 'FC' THEN bic_zio_skfq ELSE NULL END)
    ) AS bic_zio_skfq,
    MAX(flag) AS flag
  FROM (
    SELECT *, 'FC' AS flag FROM FROZEN_CUBE
    UNION ALL
    SELECT *, 'LC' AS flag FROM LIVE_CUBE
  ) combined
  WHERE
    fiscvarnt = 'K4'
    AND bic_zio_sweek BETWEEN @ip_week_ending_from AND @ip_week_ending_to
    AND bic_zio_ver = @ip_version
    AND bic_zio_saudt IN ('1', '10')
    AND bic_zio_pskf IN ('804013', '801000')
  GROUP BY
    fiscper,
    fiscvarnt,
    fiscyear,
    fiscper3,
    mandt,
    recordmode,
    bic_zio_sweek,
    b631_s_co_area,
    bic_zio_cmpcd,
    b631_s_proftctr,
    b631_s_costcntr,
    b631_s_chrtacct,
    b631_s_funcarea,
    bic_zio_ver,
    bic_zio_saudt,
    bic_zio_psty,
    bic_zio_pskf,
    unit
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 4: HIER_NODE
-- Logic: Filters the HRRP_NODE hierarchy table to rows where
--        parnode ends with 'CORERET' (HANA match(PARNODE,'*CORERET'))
--        and hryvalto = '9999-12-31' (valid-to date = max date).
--        mandt filter IN ('120','200') is applied per CV_BASE_MD_HRRP_NODE_S4.
--        BQ_DATATYPE for mandt (HRRP_NODE) = STRING; filter uses strings.
--        BQ_DATATYPE for hryvalto = DATE; '99991231' in HANA maps to
--        DATE '9999-12-31' in BigQuery.
-- Source: edp-qa-finstorage.edp_saps4_shared_cnsv.v_hrrp_node
-- Filters: mandt IN ('120','200'); REGEXP_CONTAINS(parnode, r'CORERET$');
--          hryvalto = DATE '9999-12-31'
-- =====================================================================
HIER_NODE AS (
  SELECT
    mandt,
    hryid,
    hryver,
    nodecls,
    hrynode,
    parnode,
    hryvalto,
    hryvalfrom,
    balind,
    nodetype,
    nodevalue
  FROM
    `edp-qa-finstorage.edp_saps4_shared_cnsv.v_hrrp_node`
  WHERE
    mandt IN ('120', '200')
    AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(parnode, r'CORERET$')
    AND hryvalto = DATE '9999-12-31'
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 5: Join_1 (Weekly Snapshot joined with Hierarchy)
-- Logic: Inner join of WEEKLY_SNAPSHOT_DS05 with HIER_NODE on
--        b631_s_costcntr = nodevalue. This restricts budget records
--        to those whose cost center belongs to the CORERET hierarchy.
-- Source: WEEKLY_SNAPSHOT_DS05, HIER_NODE
-- Join: INNER JOIN on wsd.b631_s_costcntr = hn.nodevalue
-- =====================================================================
Join_1 AS (
  SELECT
    wsd.fiscper,
    wsd.fiscvarnt,
    wsd.fiscyear,
    wsd.fiscper3,
    wsd.mandt,
    wsd.recordmode,
    wsd.bic_zio_sweek,
    wsd.b631_s_co_area,
    wsd.bic_zio_cmpcd,
    wsd.b631_s_proftctr,
    wsd.b631_s_costcntr,
    wsd.b631_s_chrtacct,
    wsd.b631_s_funcarea,
    wsd.bic_zio_ver,
    wsd.bic_zio_saudt,
    wsd.bic_zio_psty,
    wsd.bic_zio_pskf,
    wsd.unit,
    wsd.bic_zio_skfq,
    wsd.flag
  FROM WEEKLY_SNAPSHOT_DS05 wsd
  INNER JOIN HIER_NODE hn
    ON wsd.b631_s_costcntr = hn.nodevalue
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 6: STORE_ATTR_ACTUAL
-- Logic: Provides store/profit center attribute data populated by
--        STP_WSS_SRP_ATTRIBUTES into TBL_WSS_SRP_ATTR_ACT.
--        The procedure inserts all rows from CV_BASE_MD_SRPACT_S4
--        (which reads ZTSRP_ATTR_ACT filtered to mandt IN ('120','200'))
--        into TBL_WSS_SRP_ATTR_ACT. The staging table is replaced here
--        by inlining the procedure's INSERT…SELECT source logic.
--        CV_COMP_MD_SRPACT_STATIC then aggregates (SUM) the measures
--        from TBL_WSS_SRP_ATTR_ACT. Since the procedure fully replaces
--        the table contents, the inline SELECT from the physical source
--        with the same aggregation is equivalent.
--        BQ_DATATYPE for mandt (ZTSRP_ATTR_ACT) = STRING.
-- Source: edp-qa-finstorage.edp_saps4_shared_cnsv.v_ztsrp_attr_act
-- Filters: mandt IN ('120','200')
-- Aggregation: GROUP BY all non-measure columns; SUM on rx_hrs_oper,
--              fs_hrs_oper, rx_store, retail_sqft_amt, total_sqft_amt
-- =====================================================================
STORE_ATTR_ACTUAL AS (
  SELECT
    mandt,
    strnum,
    prctr,
    kokrs,
    kostl,
    rx_open_dat,
    rx_close_dat,
    fs_open_dat,
    fs_close_dat,
    rep_mkt_code,
    rep_mkt_desc,
    address,
    city,
    state,
    zipcode,
    division_code,
    division_desc,
    division_mgr,
    area_code,
    area_desc,
    area_mgr,
    region_code,
    region_desc,
    region_mgr,
    district_code,
    district_desc,
    zone_code,
    district_mgr,
    zone_desc,
    major_region_code,
    major_region,
    store_type,
    store_type_desc,
    rx_store_desc,
    distribution_cntr,
    distribution_cntr_desc,
    store_24_hr,
    budget_open_dat,
    budget_closed_dat,
    budget_reloc_dat,
    const_open_dat,
    const_close_dat,
    const_relo_dat,
    relocation_dat,
    emerg_mkt_ind,
    budget_emerg_mkt_ind,
    company_code,
    company_code_desc,
    original_fs_open_dat,
    original_rx_open_dat,
    group_one,
    group_two,
    ard_sort_key,
    area_cost_center,
    regiion_cost_center,
    county_code,
    county_desc,
    sqft_bracket_desc,
    sqft_sort_key,
    acquisition_code,
    acquisition_desc,
    photo_lab_add_dat,
    photo_lab_close_dat,
    min_hrs_ind,
    createdby,
    created_on,
    rx_division_code,
    rx_area_code,
    rx_region_code,
    rx_district_code,
    SUM(rx_hrs_oper)      AS rx_hrs_oper,
    SUM(fs_hrs_oper)      AS fs_hrs_oper,
    SUM(rx_store)         AS rx_store,
    SUM(retail_sqft_amt)  AS retail_sqft_amt,
    SUM(total_sqft_amt)   AS total_sqft_amt
  FROM
    `edp-qa-finstorage.edp_saps4_shared_cnsv.v_ztsrp_attr_act`
  WHERE
    mandt IN ('120', '200')
  GROUP BY
    mandt,
    strnum,
    prctr,
    kokrs,
    kostl,
    rx_open_dat,
    rx_close_dat,
    fs_open_dat,
    fs_close_dat,
    rep_mkt_code,
    rep_mkt_desc,
    address,
    city,
    state,
    zipcode,
    division_code,
    division_desc,
    division_mgr,
    area_code,
    area_desc,
    area_mgr,
    region_code,
    region_desc,
    region_mgr,
    district_code,
    district_desc,
    zone_code,
    district_mgr,
    zone_desc,
    major_region_code,
    major_region,
    store_type,
    store_type_desc,
    rx_store_desc,
    distribution_cntr,
    distribution_cntr_desc,
    store_24_hr,
    budget_open_dat,
    budget_closed_dat,
    budget_reloc_dat,
    const_open_dat,
    const_close_dat,
    const_relo_dat,
    relocation_dat,
    emerg_mkt_ind,
    budget_emerg_mkt_ind,
    company_code,
    company_code_desc,
    original_fs_open_dat,
    original_rx_open_dat,
    group_one,
    group_two,
    ard_sort_key,
    area_cost_center,
    regiion_cost_center,
    county_code,
    county_desc,
    sqft_bracket_desc,
    sqft_sort_key,
    acquisition_code,
    acquisition_desc,
    photo_lab_add_dat,
    photo_lab_close_dat,
    min_hrs_ind,
    createdby,
    created_on,
    rx_division_code,
    rx_area_code,
    rx_region_code,
    rx_district_code
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 7: Join_2 (Weekly+Hierarchy joined with Store Attributes)
-- Logic: Left join of Join_1 with STORE_ATTR_ACTUAL on
--        b631_s_proftctr = prctr. Enriches budget records with
--        store/profit center attributes.
-- Source: Join_1, STORE_ATTR_ACTUAL
-- Join: LEFT JOIN on j.b631_s_proftctr = s.prctr
-- =====================================================================
Join_2 AS (
  SELECT
    j.fiscper,
    j.fiscvarnt,
    j.fiscyear,
    j.fiscper3,
    j.mandt,
    j.recordmode,
    j.bic_zio_sweek,
    j.b631_s_co_area,
    j.bic_zio_cmpcd,
    j.b631_s_proftctr,
    j.b631_s_costcntr,
    j.bic_zio_ver,
    j.bic_zio_saudt,
    j.bic_zio_psty,
    j.bic_zio_pskf,
    j.unit,
    j.bic_zio_skfq,
    j.flag,
    s.rep_mkt_code,
    s.rep_mkt_desc,
    s.emerg_mkt_ind,
    s.strnum,
    s.division_code,
    s.division_desc,
    s.area_code,
    s.area_desc,
    s.district_code,
    s.district_desc,
    s.region_code,
    s.region_desc,
    s.city,
    s.state,
    s.fs_open_dat,
    s.rx_open_dat,
    s.rx_division_code,
    s.rx_area_code,
    s.rx_region_code,
    s.rx_district_code
  FROM Join_1 j
  LEFT JOIN STORE_ATTR_ACTUAL s
    ON j.b631_s_proftctr = s.prctr
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 8: COMP_FLAG_BUDGET_SRC
-- Logic: Provides competition flag data populated by
--        STP_WSS_SRP_ATTRIBUTES into TBL_WSS_SRP_COMPFLAG.
--        The procedure inserts rows from CV_BASE_MD_COMPFL_S4
--        (which reads ZTSRP_COMPFL filtered to mandt IN ('110','200'))
--        into TBL_WSS_SRP_COMPFLAG, filtered to zweek = @v_week
--        (the prior fiscal week from SFN_PRIOR_FISCAL_WEEK()).
--        CV_COMP_MD_COMPFL_STATIC then projects all columns from
--        TBL_WSS_SRP_COMPFLAG without further filters.
--        CV_COMP_SKF_BUDGET_STATIC applies COMP_VER = @ip_version.
--        The staging table is replaced by inlining the procedure's
--        INSERT…SELECT source logic with its filter zweek = @v_week.
--        BQ_DATATYPE for mandt (ZTSRP_COMPFL) = STRING;
--        BQ_DATATYPE for zweek (ZTSRP_COMPFL) = STRING.
-- Source: edp-qa-finstorage.edp_saps4_shared_cnsv.v_ztsrp_compfl
-- Filters: mandt IN ('110','200'); zweek = @v_week; comp_ver = @ip_version
-- =====================================================================
COMP_FLAG_BUDGET_SRC AS (
  SELECT
    mandt,
    prctr,
    strnum,
    comp_ver,
    zweek,
    zmonth,
    zyear,
    fs_comp_pre,
    rx_comp_pre,
    fs_comp_mon,
    rx_comp_mon,
    fs_comp_wk,
    rx_comp_wk
  FROM
    `edp-qa-finstorage.edp_saps4_shared_cnsv.v_ztsrp_compfl`
  WHERE
    mandt IN ('110', '200')
    AND zweek = @v_week
    AND comp_ver = @ip_version
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 9: Join_3 (Join_2 joined with Competition Flags)
-- Logic: Left join of Join_2 with COMP_FLAG_BUDGET_SRC on
--        b631_s_proftctr = prctr AND bic_zio_sweek = zweek.
--        Enriches budget records with weekly competition flag data.
-- Source: Join_2, COMP_FLAG_BUDGET_SRC
-- Join: LEFT JOIN on j.b631_s_proftctr = c.prctr
--       AND j.bic_zio_sweek = c.zweek
-- =====================================================================
Join_3 AS (
  SELECT
    j.fiscper,
    j.fiscvarnt,
    j.fiscyear,
    j.fiscper3,
    j.mandt,
    j.recordmode,
    j.bic_zio_sweek,
    j.b631_s_co_area,
    j.bic_zio_cmpcd,
    j.b631_s_proftctr,
    j.b631_s_costcntr,
    j.bic_zio_ver,
    j.bic_zio_saudt,
    j.bic_zio_psty,
    j.bic_zio_pskf,
    j.unit,
    j.bic_zio_skfq,
    j.flag,
    j.rep_mkt_code,
    j.rep_mkt_desc,
    j.emerg_mkt_ind,
    j.strnum,
    j.division_code,
    j.division_desc,
    j.area_code,
    j.area_desc,
    j.district_code,
    j.district_desc,
    j.region_code,
    j.region_desc,
    j.city,
    j.state,
    j.fs_open_dat,
    j.rx_open_dat,
    j.rx_division_code,
    j.rx_area_code,
    j.rx_region_code,
    j.rx_district_code,
    c.rx_comp_wk
  FROM Join_2 j
  LEFT JOIN COMP_FLAG_BUDGET_SRC c
    ON j.b631_s_proftctr = c.prctr
    AND j.bic_zio_sweek = c.zweek
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 10: CAL_WEEK
-- Logic: Provides retail calendar week attributes from ZTFIGL_RCALWEEK.
--        Filtered to rclnt IN ('120','200') per CV_BASE_MD_RCALWEEK_S4.
--        BQ_DATATYPE for rclnt (ZTFIGL_RCALWEEK) = STRING.
--        BQ_DATATYPE for zzweek = STRING (NUMC).
--        BQ_DATATYPE for zrwstrtdate = DATE; BQ_DATATYPE for zrwenddate = DATE.
-- Source: edp-qa-finstorage.edp_saps4_shared_cnsv.v_ztfigl_rcalweek
-- Filters: rclnt IN ('120','200')
-- =====================================================================
CAL_WEEK AS (
  SELECT
    rclnt,
    zzweek,
    zcalyrp,
    zryear,
    zrperiod,
    zryrp,
    zryrqtr,
    zrwstrtdate,
    zrwenddate
  FROM
    `edp-qa-finstorage.edp_saps4_shared_cnsv.v_ztfigl_rcalweek`
  WHERE
    rclnt IN ('120', '200')
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 11: Join_4 (Join_3 joined with Calendar Week)
-- Logic: Left join of Join_3 with CAL_WEEK on
--        bic_zio_sweek = zzweek. Enriches budget records with
--        calendar week start/end dates.
--        Both bic_zio_sweek (STRING) and zzweek (STRING) — same type.
-- Source: Join_3, CAL_WEEK
-- Join: LEFT JOIN on j.bic_zio_sweek = cw.zzweek
-- =====================================================================
Join_4 AS (
  SELECT
    j.fiscper,
    j.fiscvarnt,
    j.fiscyear,
    j.fiscper3,
    j.mandt,
    j.recordmode,
    j.bic_zio_sweek,
    j.b631_s_co_area,
    j.bic_zio_cmpcd,
    j.b631_s_proftctr,
    j.b631_s_costcntr,
    j.bic_zio_ver,
    j.bic_zio_saudt,
    j.bic_zio_psty,
    j.bic_zio_pskf,
    j.unit,
    j.bic_zio_skfq,
    j.flag,
    j.rep_mkt_code,
    j.rep_mkt_desc,
    j.emerg_mkt_ind,
    j.strnum,
    j.division_code,
    j.division_desc,
    j.area_code,
    j.area_desc,
    j.district_code,
    j.district_desc,
    j.region_code,
    j.region_desc,
    j.city,
    j.state,
    j.fs_open_dat,
    j.rx_open_dat,
    j.rx_division_code,
    j.rx_area_code,
    j.rx_region_code,
    j.rx_district_code,
    j.rx_comp_wk,
    cw.zrwenddate,
    cw.zrwstrtdate
  FROM Join_3 j
  LEFT JOIN CAL_WEEK cw
    ON j.bic_zio_sweek = cw.zzweek
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 12: PROFIT_CENTER_TEXT
-- Logic: Provides profit center text descriptions from CEPCT.
--        Filtered to mandt IN ('120','200') per CV_BASE_MD_CEPCT_S4.
--        BQ_DATATYPE for mandt (CEPCT) = STRING.
--        BQ_DATATYPE for datbi = DATE.
--        Only ltext (long text) is used as profit_center_text per the
--        final consumer's output contract.
-- Source: edp-qa-finstorage.edp_saps4_shared_cnsv.v_cepct
-- Filters: mandt IN ('120','200')
-- =====================================================================
PROFIT_CENTER_TEXT AS (
  SELECT
    mandt,
    prctr,
    spras,
    datbi,
    kokrs,
    ktext,
    ltext,
    mctxt
  FROM
    `edp-qa-finstorage.edp_saps4_shared_cnsv.v_cepct`
  WHERE
    mandt IN ('120', '200')
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 13: Join_5 (Join_4 joined with Profit Center Text)
-- Logic: Left join of Join_4 with PROFIT_CENTER_TEXT on
--        b631_s_proftctr = prctr. Enriches budget records with
--        profit center long text (ltext → profit_center_text).
-- Source: Join_4, PROFIT_CENTER_TEXT
-- Join: LEFT JOIN on j.b631_s_proftctr = pct.prctr
-- =====================================================================
Join_5 AS (
  SELECT
    j.fiscper,
    j.fiscvarnt,
    j.fiscyear,
    j.fiscper3,
    j.mandt,
    j.recordmode,
    j.bic_zio_sweek,
    j.b631_s_co_area,
    j.bic_zio_cmpcd,
    j.b631_s_proftctr,
    j.b631_s_costcntr,
    j.bic_zio_ver,
    j.bic_zio_saudt,
    j.bic_zio_psty,
    j.bic_zio_pskf,
    j.unit,
    j.bic_zio_skfq,
    j.flag,
    j.rep_mkt_code,
    j.rep_mkt_desc,
    j.emerg_mkt_ind,
    j.strnum,
    j.division_code,
    j.division_desc,
    j.area_code,
    j.area_desc,
    j.district_code,
    j.district_desc,
    j.region_code,
    j.region_desc,
    j.city,
    j.state,
    j.fs_open_dat,
    j.rx_open_dat,
    j.rx_division_code,
    j.rx_area_code,
    j.rx_region_code,
    j.rx_district_code,
    j.rx_comp_wk,
    j.zrwenddate,
    j.zrwstrtdate,
    pct.ltext AS profit_center_text
  FROM Join_4 j
  LEFT JOIN PROFIT_CENTER_TEXT pct
    ON j.b631_s_proftctr = pct.prctr
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 14: FLAGS
-- Logic: Final projection before aggregation. Applies the three
--        calculated columns from CV_COMP_SKF_BUDGET_STATIC:
--          cal_week_number: RIGHT(bic_zio_sweek, 2) — last 2 chars of week
--          cal_bic_zio_skfq: IF bic_zio_pskf='804013' THEN skfq*2 ELSE skfq
--          cal_rx_comp_wk: IF rx_comp_wk IS NULL THEN '0' ELSE rx_comp_wk
--        bic_zio_sweek is STRING (BQ_DATATYPE), so RIGHT() is valid.
--        bic_zio_skfq is FLOAT64 (BQ_DATATYPE for AZSRP_DS092/DS031);
--        multiplication by 2 returns FLOAT64.
-- Source: Join_5
-- Calculation: cal_week_number, cal_bic_zio_skfq, cal_rx_comp_wk
-- =====================================================================
FLAGS AS (
  SELECT
    fiscper,
    fiscvarnt,
    fiscyear,
    fiscper3,
    mandt,
    recordmode,
    bic_zio_sweek,
    b631_s_co_area,
    bic_zio_cmpcd,
    b631_s_proftctr,
    b631_s_costcntr,
    bic_zio_ver,
    bic_zio_saudt,
    bic_zio_psty,
    bic_zio_pskf,
    unit,
    bic_zio_skfq,
    flag,
    rep_mkt_code,
    rep_mkt_desc,
    emerg_mkt_ind,
    strnum,
    division_code,
    division_desc,
    area_code,
    area_desc,
    district_code,
    district_desc,
    region_code,
    region_desc,
    city,
    state,
    fs_open_dat,
    rx_open_dat,
    rx_division_code,
    rx_area_code,
    rx_region_code,
    rx_district_code,
    zrwenddate,
    zrwstrtdate,
    profit_center_text,
    rx_comp_wk,
    -- Calculated columns per CV_COMP_SKF_BUDGET_STATIC FLAGS node
    RIGHT(bic_zio_sweek, 2)                                                          AS cal_week_number,
    CASE WHEN bic_zio_pskf = '804013' THEN bic_zio_skfq * 2 ELSE bic_zio_skfq END  AS cal_bic_zio_skfq,
    CASE WHEN rx_comp_wk IS NULL THEN '0' ELSE rx_comp_wk END                        AS cal_rx_comp_wk
  FROM Join_5
)

-- =====================================================================
-- FINAL SELECT: CV_COMP_SKF_BUDGET_STATIC Output
-- Logic: Aggregation (CUBE/Aggregation view) over FLAGS node.
--        Two measures:
--          bic_zio_skfq_negative = SUM(bic_zio_skfq)  [raw skfq, negative-capable]
--          bic_zio_skfq          = SUM(cal_bic_zio_skfq) [adjusted: *2 for pskf=804013]
--        All other columns are GROUP BY attributes.
--        cal_rx_comp_wk is output as rx_comp_wk (meaningful rename per output contract).
--        flag is output as skf_bud_cube (meaningful rename per output contract).
--        All output column names use exact BQ_COLUMN values from Columns_Mapping.
-- Source: FLAGS
-- Aggregation: SUM(bic_zio_skfq) AS bic_zio_skfq_negative;
--              SUM(cal_bic_zio_skfq) AS bic_zio_skfq
-- =====================================================================
SELECT
  mandt,
  fiscper,
  fiscvarnt,
  fiscyear,
  fiscper3,
  recordmode,
  bic_zio_sweek,
  b631_s_co_area,
  bic_zio_cmpcd,
  b631_s_proftctr,
  b631_s_costcntr,
  bic_zio_ver,
  bic_zio_saudt,
  rep_mkt_code,
  rep_mkt_desc,
  emerg_mkt_ind,
  bic_zio_psty,
  bic_zio_pskf,
  unit,
  division_code,
  division_desc,
  area_code,
  area_desc,
  district_code,
  district_desc,
  region_code,
  region_desc,
  cal_week_number,
  strnum,
  zrwenddate,
  zrwstrtdate,
  city,
  state,
  profit_center_text,
  fs_open_dat,
  rx_open_dat,
  cal_rx_comp_wk                    AS rx_comp_wk,
  flag                              AS skf_bud_cube,
  rx_division_code,
  rx_area_code,
  rx_region_code,
  rx_district_code,
  -- Measures
  SUM(bic_zio_skfq)                 AS bic_zio_skfq_negative,
  SUM(cal_bic_zio_skfq)             AS bic_zio_skfq
FROM FLAGS
GROUP BY
  mandt,
  fiscper,
  fiscvarnt,
  fiscyear,
  fiscper3,
  recordmode,
  bic_zio_sweek,
  b631_s_co_area,
  bic_zio_cmpcd,
  b631_s_proftctr,
  b631_s_costcntr,
  bic_zio_ver,
  bic_zio_saudt,
  rep_mkt_code,
  rep_mkt_desc,
  emerg_mkt_ind,
  bic_zio_psty,
  bic_zio_pskf,
  unit,
  division_code,
  division_desc,
  area_code,
  area_desc,
  district_code,
  district_desc,
  region_code,
  region_desc,
  cal_week_number,
  strnum,
  zrwenddate,
  zrwstrtdate,
  city,
  state,
  profit_center_text,
  fs_open_dat,
  rx_open_dat,
  cal_rx_comp_wk,
  flag,
  rx_division_code,
  rx_area_code,
  rx_region_code,
  rx_district_code
;
